text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed in eu-central1 gateway cluster — threshold breached (5m p95 12%). Paging @maya.sre and @rohan_oncall

maya.sre: seeing the spike, digging in. starting with gateway logs + proxy health.

rohan_oncall: on-call here — I've pulled the initial dashboards. Errors concentrated on gateway-proxy-euc1-{a,b} pools, mainly 502/504 timeouts. No obvious pod OOMs.

jessica_prod: customers flagged slow responses in EU. CS already got a handful of support tickets referencing 502s on inference calls. Sam, can you triangulate customer impact?

sam_cs: quick summary: 5 paying customers reported degraded UX. One enterprise pipeline retried and hit throttles. I'll prepare a status snippet for comms.

eli_network: looks like upstream egress to mlworker-euc1 is timing out. tcp retransmits rising on the egress NAT. Could be conntrack exhaustion or a NAT gateway hiccup.

maya.sre: running runbook step 1-3. Checking connection pool metrics and conntrack stats on the egress nodes.

maya.sre: command: ```ssh jump-eu && sudo conntrack -L | wc -l``` -> returning ~480k entries (conntrack max 524k). conntrack nearing saturation.

rohan_oncall: set temporary mitigation: increase conntrack max on egress hosts and rotate the NAT pool. maya, can you apply sysctl bump and restart egress-proxy gracefully?

maya.sre: doing sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=800000 on two nodes now. Restarting egress-proxy pods with graceful drain: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/egress-proxy -n infra --grace-period=60```

deploy-bot: rollout restarted deployment/egress-proxy (3/3 updated) — pods becoming ready.

eli_network: conntrack decreased after restart to ~120k. TCP retransmits dropping. latency to mlworker-euc1 improved but still elevated for long-tail.

maya.sre: good. Now stepping through runbook: check gateway circuit-breakers and retry budgets. We've opened the circuit on the busiest pool to prevent cascading retries.

rohan_oncall: reweighted traffic on regional LB: reduced weight for euc1-proxy pool by 60% and increased fallback to eu-west1 by 40% for latency-sensitive routes. command: ```curl -X POST -d '{"pool":"euc1","weight":40}' https://lb-api/weights```

jessica_prod: enabling fallback-routing for model-serving routes in the control plane to shift to eu-west1 for low-latency SLAs. Notifying customers that EU requests may be routed to eu-west during mitigation.

sam_cs: update ready for customers: "We're seeing elevated errors in EU; we've shifted traffic to a healthy region and are working on restoring full capacity. If you see failures, please reply here and we'll escalate."

maya.sre: after reweight, error rate p95 dropped from 12% -> 3.2% in 10 minutes. Backend 5xx on mlworker-euc1 still shows tail under heavy KV cache misses. Investigating TTL churn.

eli_network: KV cache TTL churn looks tied to large prefix caching misses after egress-restart — warmup required. Suggest temporarily increasing cache retention and priming popular prefixes.

maya.sre: applying cache tweak: ```kubectl exec -n inference cache-ops -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/config -d '{"ttl_seconds":600}'``` -> applied. Priming popular keys via script.

deploy-bot: cache config update succeeded, priming job queued (20 tasks).

rohan_oncall: we should escalate to platform infra to look into NAT autoscaling / conntrack tuning long-term. Opening ticket INFRA-8473 and tagging eli_network + maya.sre.

eli_network: got the ticket. Initial notes: add extra NAT instances to the pool, investigate conntrack eviction settings, and evaluate HA NAT alternatives (Managed NAT or additional egress subnets).

jessica_prod: planning comms: send interim status to customers in 30m if stable. Anyone want to draft? I'll push through product_updates channel.

sam_cs: DM me the draft, I'll attach impacted customers list and SLA notes.

maya.sre: monitoring: overall 5xx now ~1.1% regionally, eu-central per-gateway 2.8%. Latency p95 back to baseline for most flows. Keeping the incident open for full recovery and postmortem.

rohan_oncall: handing off to night SRE: @maya.sre will lead postmortem; @eli_network will own NAT/egress follow-ups. I'll add context to the on-call log and mark for monitoring escalation if >2% 5xx again.

maya.sre: taking ownership. Notes for handoff: mitigation applied (conntrack bump, egress-proxy restart, cache TTL increase, LB reweight to eu-west1), customer comms queued, ticket INFRA-8473 created.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place, error-rate decreased. Incident state: mitigated -> investigating. Pager cleared for on-call rotation.

jessica_prod: thanks team — will coordinate customer comms once we confirm stability.

sam_cs: closing loop with first reported customers; none report persistent failures now.

maya.sre: leaving final note: follow-up actions list: 1) NAT autoscaling + extra subnets, 2) adjust conntrack defaults, 3) improve cache cold-start priming during restarts, 4) LB weight automation for rapid reroute. Assign owners in INFRA ticket.

rohan_oncall: thumbs up. I'll update the incident channel and schedule postmortem tomorrow 11:00 CET.

incident-bot: :memo: Incident timeline recorded. Runbook reference: /runbooks/eu-gateway-conntrack.md

maya.sre: marking thread resolved for now but will reopen if metrics regress.

jessica_prod: noted. thanks all.
